Hi team, my goal here is trying to improve the wasi-nn implementation for the support of some community built jev-style decision models.

I got a bug fix PR merged already, and here is another PR I would like to get some reviews: https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime/pull/15056
(so, may I?)

I am also aware of the security issue, and if no one is working on it, I can take a look: https://github.com/bytecodealliance/wasmtime/issues/14437

CC: @Alex Crichton @Johnnie Birch @Rahul Chaphalkar
Sorry, I am not familiar with Zulip... I think this message belongs to wasmtime channel not the general one. And I don't have the permission to move it so let me start a new one there
